cards.title: Millennial Mothers and the Overwhelm of Parenthood
cards.body: Modern mothers juggle more education, employment, and childcare than previous generations, yet many feel they can't be the parent they want to be. Early intervention strategies and support systems are essential to combat parental burnout and overwhelm.

cards.title: Helicopter Joy: Unexpected Moments With Your Child
cards.body: Small acts of kindness from strangers can create lasting joy for children. A three-year-old's delight when helicopter pilots waved back shows how simple gestures build cherished memories.

cards.title: Working Parent Logistics and School Holiday Chaos
cards.body: School holidays create a scheduling nightmare for working parents, forcing difficult choices between career and childcare. More flexible work arrangements could help parents enjoy quality time with their kids without constant stress.

cards.title: Quality TV for Toddlers: Play School Returns
cards.body: Play School offers a calming alternative to frantic, attention-grabbing children's programming designed to mimic smartphone algorithms. Parents appreciate content that respects their toddler's development rather than exploiting their attention.

cards.title: Secret Codeword for Sleepover Safety
cards.body: Teaching children a discreet codeword allows them to signal distress at sleepovers without embarrassment. This simple safety tool empowers kids to reach out when they're uncomfortable.

cards.title: Family Holiday Dynamics and Parental Self-Care
cards.body: After decades of managing everyone's needs on family trips, parents deserve to have their own needs recognized and met. Shifting responsibility allows parents to avoid burnout and enjoy vacations alongside their children.

cards.title: Mental Load in Relationships and Family Dynamics
cards.body: An imbalance in domestic duties and mental load often falls on mothers, creating burnout and relationship strain. Open conversations about sharing household responsibilities can help prevent both exhaustion and breakups.

cards.title: Talking to Children About Sex and Boundaries
cards.body: Early, ongoing conversations about bodies, boundaries, privacy, consent, and sexuality help children develop healthy relationships. Age-appropriate discussions starting in childhood establish foundations for sexual health and safety.

cards.title: Supporting College-Age Children's Independence
cards.body: Your college student needs you differently than before—shifting toward supporting independence while remaining available matters. Three key adjustments help parents navigate this crucial developmental transition.

cards.title: Anger and Physical Punishment in Parenting
cards.body: Understanding the difference between frustration and anger helps parents recognize when discipline crosses into harmful territory. Managing parental anger is crucial for child safety and emotional wellbeing.

cards.title: Adult Children Not Meeting Parental Expectations
cards.body: When adult children diverge from parents' hopes, anger and shame often follow, but five constructive steps can restore peace. Finding acceptance allows parents to rebuild healthier relationships.

cards.title: Sextortion: A Growing Threat to Young People
cards.body: Sextortion—online victimization targeting kids—causes serious psychological harm and deserves discussion in suicide prevention efforts. Teaching children how to avoid and respond to sextortion keeps them safer online.

cards.title: School Sleep Programs: Modest Success and Improvement
cards.body: School-based programs to improve student sleep have shown only modest results so far. Recent research identifies strategies that could make these interventions more effective for teenagers.

cards.title: Healing From Divorce as an Adult Child
cards.body: Adult children of high-conflict gray divorce can carry emotional wounds for decades, but radical acceptance offers a path to healing. Moving beyond grief requires releasing old patterns and finding peace.

cards.title: Lithium Battery Fire Kills Mother and Children
cards.body: A lithium-ion battery fire claimed the lives of Elisha Brabin, 36, and three of her children in their Merseyside home. This tragedy highlights the serious safety risks posed by these batteries in household items.
